svg.title: Every mirror meeting
svg.desc: A complete atlas of the higher mirror-axis meetings on the unperturbed outward offset families. Rhythms 11 / 6 have eleven fourfolds; 11 / 8 have nine. Each card shows the four unit left normals in visit colors and the four certified triple signs in order 123, 124, 134, 234. Twelve circles have four negative signs, seven have two of each, and one has four positive signs. The all-positive circle is at outward distance 284.56257 on 11 / 6. All circles use the same equal coordinate scales. There are no ordinary axis triples and no axis meetings with six or more visits. Off-axis events remain unclassified.

g.text: Seven eligible arcs per drawing. Twenty circles where four visits come together.
44 local triples after small symmetry-breaking shifts
36 local triples after small symmetry-breaking shifts
One sign comes from three directions.
Read each triple of normals in orbit order.
Close marks may overlap. Signs use exact certificates.
M = outward distance · X = center on the mirror axis
Every circle uses equal coordinate scales. The sign counts refer to local generic resolutions of the fourfolds.
Axis census for M ≥ 0. The later whole-leg census also closes the off-axis question.
